caption: The drawing depicts a single ornamental object centered on a plain, beige background. The object has an ovular shape with a diamond-patterned texture on the upper section, colored in a mix of light brown and ochre tones. The lower and upper portions of the object are decorated with carved, leaf-like structures that curve outward and are colored in dark greenish-grey and muted brown hues. The object appears symmetrical with a vertical orientation, and no additional elements or objects are present in the composition.
title: Wood Tradesman's Sign
